name: aeroguide
description: AeroGuide: aviation and airport intelligence for India

scripts.dev:api: cd apps/api && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.migrate: cd apps/api && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.seed: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.seed
scripts.seed:check: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.seed --check
scripts.data-check: cd apps/api && uv run python -m app.jobs.data_check --output data-check-report.md
scripts.lint:api: cd apps/api && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.fmt: pnpm --filter web fmt && cd apps/api && uv run ruff format . && uv run ruff check --fix .
